metadata.name: Hermes Desktop Design System
metadata.description: Design system extracted from Hermes Desktop via Reverse Engineering Assistant (REA)
metadata.extraction_method: REA analysis of source code and DESIGN.md

design_tokens.`--ui-stroke-tertiary`: the default in-panel divider / list hairline — and every bordered surface in the transcript

loaders.description: Mathematical curve-based loaders (lemniscate, rose curves, spirals, cardioids, etc.)
loaders.implementation: Uses requestAnimationFrame with parametric curves for smooth, performant animations

button.description: Single Button component with variant and size props

widget_shell.description: Shared shell for inline transcript widgets (clarify, artifact cards)

design_principles: Flat, not boxed - No card-in-card, no divider borders inside a panel. Group with whitespace and a single hairline, never nested rounded boxes.
Borderless elevation for floating panels - Overlays float on shadow-nous + a --stroke-nous hairline, not thick framed boxes.
One primitive per concern - One Button, one set of control variants, one SearchField, one Loader, one ErrorState. Migrate onto them; don't fork.
Tokens, not literals - Reference CSS vars (--ui-*, --shadow-nous, --theme-*), never raw hex / ad-hoc rgba in components.
Style lives in the primitive - Variants and sizes own padding, radius, color, chrome. Call sites pass a variant/size, not className overrides that re-specify those.
Intent before automation - Surface useful actions and previews, but do not open panes, move focus, or navigate because a tool happened to produce something.
Immediate feedback - Direct manipulation updates the view first. Network or disk persistence reconciles afterward and rolls back visibly on failure.

usage_guidelines.css_variables: Use tokens as CSS variables: var(--token-name)
usage_guidelines.color_usage: Never use hardcoded hex colors; always reference design tokens
usage_guidelines.layout_principles: Prefer flat layouts with whitespace over nested boxes
usage_guidelines.interaction_feedback: Provide immediate visual feedback for user actions
